description: This file defines the 'Message' class which models a request message in an IPC (Inter-Process Communication) system. It includes methods for generating C code for native communication, handling input/output parameters, and generating Java interface code for message handling. The class encapsulates message properties, related functions, and detailed code generation logic for both C and Java environments.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Main class modeling an IPC message with code generation for C and Java, including nested class for native function representations.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares two Message objects based on their message code for sorting.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the message.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the numeric ID of the message.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides the description of the message if available.

methods.name: getReadTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the read timeout value for the message.

methods.name: supportsC
methods.description: Indicates if C code generation is supported for this message.

methods.name: supportsJava
methods.description: Indicates if Java code generation is supported for this message.

methods.name: calculateNativeFunctions
methods.description: Generates C functions for native IPC message handling, including API functions and handler implementations.

methods.name: addNativeCodeDefines
methods.description: Adds #define symbols for the message to a code formatter table.

methods.name: getNativeApiFunctionDeclarations
methods.description: Retrieves C function declarations related to the message.

methods.name: getNativeApiFunctionImplementations
methods.description: Retrieves C function implementations related to the message.

methods.name: generateJavaInterface
methods.description: Generates Java code for interface definitions related to the message, including final int constants and freeform documentation.

methods.name: generateJavaCaseLines
methods.description: Creates Java code for handling this message as a case in a switch statement for IPC handling, decoding input, calling handler, encoding output.

methods.name: generateDirectJavaCaseLines
methods.description: Creates Java code for direct message handling without JSON decoding, assuming inputs are already deserialized.

methods.name: generateJavaImplementationLines
methods.description: Generates Java abstract method declaration for handling the message, to be implemented by subclasses.
